FND-02-LANGUAGE-SIGNOFF.title: Cross-functional user-language contract approval
FND-02-LANGUAGE-SIGNOFF.attestation: I reviewed the identified language contract for the identified build and approve it for my named role.
FND-02-LANGUAGE-SIGNOFF.passRule: All four required roles provide distinct named approvals bound to the same build SHA and language-contract digest.

HR-01.presentation: Show the release-candidate state card with its state label hidden. Do not explain the state before the response.
HR-01.exactPrompt: 请用自己的话回答三个问题：现在发生了什么？为什么这件事重要？你下一步会怎么做？

scoring.correctRule: Correct only when the response covers all three rubric elements: current situation, user impact, and valid next step.
scoring.formula: correct participant-prompt results / all participant-prompt results

FND-03-SPOT-CHECK.title: Deterministic twenty-percent adjudication review
FND-03-SPOT-CHECK.reviewPrompt: For each selected scenario, inspect the execution record and its cited evidence. Does the recorded automated or deferred decision follow the protocol without overstating a pass?
FND-03-SPOT-CHECK.passRule: A named reviewer agrees with all three selected decisions and signs the package.

signoff.requiredAttestation: I reviewed the recorded raw responses or artifacts against this protocol and attest that the submitted decisions are accurate for the identified build.
